description: Dams of the Murray-Darling Basin region is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Bioregional Assessment Program. Abstract This dataset was derived from borehole data provided by Geoscience Australia. You can find a link to the source dataset in the Lineage Field in this metadata statement. The History Field in this metadata statement describes how this dataset was derived. This data represents dam centroids of the Murray-Darling Basin. Coverage: Bioregional Assessment Program. The portal files it under the publisher Bioregional Assessment Program. Its tags are Australia, Gwydir subregion, Maranoa-Balonne-Condamine subregion, inlandWaters. It offers 1 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2022-04-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
